title: stability-eval-loop-rollout-controller
author: Aisha N. Patel
body:
Summary: Adds a Stability Evaluation Loop to the rollout controller that continuously assesses cohort-level signal stability (latency, error-rate, semantic drift) and pauses or reverses progressive rollouts when a configurable instability signature is observed.
Motivation: Existing canary and A/B mechanisms drive traffic increases on fixed heuristics (percent, duration) which can miss subtle, correlated regressions that only appear across cohorts or under traffic surge. The stability-eval-loop provides a lightweight, pluggable evaluator that sits between the rollout scheduler and the traffic applier to improve safety without manual intervention.
Design highlights: 1) Evaluation windowing: configurable sliding windows per cohort with warmup and burn-in periods. 2) Cohort-sampler: supports user-defined cohort keys (e.g., user_id hash modulus, country, plan tier) and automatic safe defaults. 3) Multi-signal detector: aggregates latency p50/p95, error-rate (5xx/4xx), model-quality regression via prompt-anchored checks (user-provided golden prompts), and output-distribution divergence (JS divergence on token distributions). 4) Decision policy: threshold-based gates with rate-aware hysteresis and a secondary anomaly-scoring model for suppression of noisy spikes. 5) Action engine: pause, hold, rollback-to-last-stable, or route-to-fallback; integrates with existing rollout CRD and audit log. 6) Telemetry: emits per-cohort metrics and decision traces; ties into Console rollout-inspector for UI visibility.
Config knobs:
- rollout.controller.stability.window: "60s-15m"
- rollout.controller.stability.min_samples: 100
- rollout.controller.stability.hysteresis: 2x consecutive windows
- rollout.controller.stability.signals: [latency,error_rate,drift]
- rollout.controller.stability.fallback: [rollback,route-fallback]
- rollout.controller.stability.enabled: true
Backwards compatibility: Default configuration is disabled. When enabled, the controller reads RolloutPolicy.v1->stability (optional); if absent, no gating is performed.
Migration: Helm chart includes opt-in flag --set rollout.stability.enabled=true. Operators upgrading clusters with custom RolloutPolicy should add a stability section if they want enforcement.
Tests and validation:
- Unit tests for detector thresholds and hysteresis (rollout/controller/eval_loop_test.go)
- Integration test harness simulating 3 cohorts with orchestrated latency spikes and semantic drift; verified automated pause and rollback behaviors.
- End-to-end smoke in perf-canary lab using small scale models before rolling to prod.
Security & privacy: Only pre-aggregated metrics are used by default. Golden-prompt evaluations can be encrypted via KMS and are optional.
Audit trail: every automated action adds an audit event with reason and telemetry snapshot.
Rollout plan:
1) Deploy controller in staging with feature flag off.
2) Enable in staging for 24h with verbose traces.
3) Canary in us-west with 5% traffic on non-critical tenants for 48h.
4) Gradual enablement with ops on-call aware.
Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-2043)
- [x] Unit and integration tests added
- [x] Console inspector hooks implemented
- [x] Metrics and tracing emitted
- [x] Helm flag and CRD optional fields added
- [x] Rollout playbook updated (docs/runbooks/stability-rollouts.md)
Risks & mitigations:
- False positives: mitigated via hysteresis, min_samples, and score suppression model.
- Increased control-plane load: evaluation loop batches checks and is rate-limited by default.
- Operator surprise: default off and rollout inspector surfaces decisions for human override.
Alternatives considered: stronger A/B instrumentation in user-space (requires app changes), or full shadow replay (higher infra cost). This approach balances safety, low infra cost, and immediate operational visibility.
Related work: ties into shard-aware-cohort-sampling in ENG-2211 and leverages metrics from observability-pack.
Linear refs: ENG-2043 (design), ENG-2211 (cohort sampler).
Release notes: Adds a stability evaluation gate to progressive rollouts; disabled by default. See docs/runbooks/stability-rollouts.md for operator guidance.
commit_summary: init: add eval loop controller, detector interfaces, and basic windowing
feat: implement cohort sampler and multi-signal aggregator
feat: integrate action engine with rollout CRD and audit events
chore: add console hooks, metrics, helm flag and docs
files_changed: rollout/controller/eval_loop.go: added StabilityEvalLoop with windowing, cohort sampling, and decision pipeline
rollout/controller/eval_loop_test.go: unit tests for hysteresis and thresholding; synthetic spike harness
console/ui/rollout-inspector.tsx: shows per-cohort stability timeline and last decision with reason
docs/runbooks/stability-rollouts.md: operator runbook and playbook for investigating automated pauses
helm/charts/redwood/templates/rollout-crd.yaml: optional stability section and feature flag
review_comments: Markus Green: Nice work — can you explain why JS divergence was chosen over KL for token distribution drift?
Aisha N. Patel: JS gives symmetric bounded divergence and is less sensitive to zero-probability issues which we hit in preliminary tests.
Elena Ruiz: Please add a guard so the golden-prompt evaluator can't leak user prompts into logs.
Aisha N. Patel: Good catch — golden-prompt evaluator is now KMS-encrypted and we redact prompt text from traces. Added test coverage.
Kai Huang: CI showed a flaky test in the integration harness; suggest increasing timeouts rather than skipping.
Aisha N. Patel: Increased harness timeouts and added jitter control to eliminate timing races. Re-ran CI; green.
ci_checks: unit-tests: pass (98.7% coverage on modified package)
release_notes: Introduce an opt-in Stability Evaluation Loop for progressive rollouts: stability gates (latency/error/drift), per-cohort decisioning, and automated actions (pause/rollback/fallback). Disabled by default; see docs/runbooks/stability-rollouts.md for operational guidance.
notes_for_ops: Default min_samples is 100 — tune for low-traffic cohorts
If you see frequent auto-pauses, review rollout_stability_score and increase hysteresis or min_samples
On rollback events, use rollout-inspector to replay the telemetry snapshot attached to the audit event
